title: Aerospace companies ask for Pasulka's angel data

tellings.quote: inquiries from people at aerospace companies and not just one I got a lot

plain: Around 2012, when the religious studies professor Diana Pasulka began studying reports of angels and heavenly visitors, people from several aerospace companies got in touch asking for her data, she tells Michels. She stresses it was "not just one, I got a lot." She tells it as a sign that people in the aerospace business saw something in old religious accounts that bore on their own work.
